label: WRONG
reason: Zod schemas in admin-router *.types files are named Z*Schema (get-user.types.ts, find-documents.types.ts), and ZAdminRoleSelection is a zod enum that drifts from that scheme (mistake), but ADMIN_SEARCH_MAX_QUERY_LENGTH is a plain constant, a recurring kind of export in *.types files (MAX_PROFILE_BIO_LENGTH, ANALYTICS_CUSTOM_RANGE_MAX_LOOKBACK in sibling routers), so 1 of 2 is a tie and not ACCEPT; biome.json has no naming rule. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since the rule would be right if scoped to zod schemas.

label: ACCEPT
reason: All 93 files in dialogs/ are *-dialog.tsx and export a *Dialog component (AccountDeleteDialog, FolderDeleteDialog, OrganisationEmailDomainCreateDialog); the only exception, OrganisationEmailDomainRecordContent, is a shared part the tool already exempts, and no biome rule enforces component naming, so a new off-scheme component is a naming-scheme drift worth flagging.
